thread:
Renee M.: dropped a prototype for a compact 'board' in the trace viewer — https://figma.com/s/trace-board-compact
Renee M.: Quick brief: let users pin request cards to a temporary board while investigating errors. Board supports reordering, short notes, export (CSV/JSON), and a shareable permalink. Looking for copy, discoverability, and accessibility feedback.
Omar T.: I like the compact approach. Question: should pins represent entire requests or individual spans? If spans are pinnable we need a clear visual indicator.
Renee M.: default pins are request-level. We can allow expanding to select spans inside the board for finer exports.
Priya S.: Copy ideas: button text as action-first — "Pin request" instead of "Add". In the board: actions "Copy link", "Export selection". Tooltip on hover: "Pin request to board".
Noah K.: dev note: easiest ship is client-only (localStorage/sessionStorage). Server persistence requires endpoints and auth. Recommend session-scoped first, with a feature flag for server sync. Also enforce a 30-pin soft limit.
Omar T.: a11y checklist: pin control must be in the tab order. Tooltip should use aria-describedby. When copying a link, announce to screen readers: "Link copied to clipboard." Also ensure the board panel has role="dialog" and focus management.
Renee M.: for keyboard access I propose: focus on a trace item -> action strip appears with [Pin] and [More]. Pin is a <button aria-pressed="false">. When pressed it toggles to aria-pressed="true" and updates the board.
Priya S.: wording tweak: avoid jargon like "session" in the main CTA. Use short labels: "Pin" or "Pin request". In the board header we can show a small hint: "Pins stay in this browser tab."
Noah K.: about copying behavior: prefer explicit "Copy link" action in a tiny menu rather than copying silently on pin. Also add an inline toast: "Permalink copied." with aria-live polite.
Priya S.: Export details: default export formats: JSON and CSV. Add an "Export bundle" option that includes stack traces and metadata. The export modal should list checkboxes for including spans, stackframes, and annotations.
Omar T.: performance: large bundles can be multiple MBs. We should stream the export and show a progress bar. Enforce a size limit and indicate truncation if needed. Track telemetry: how many pins, export format, and whether copy was used.
Priya S.: file naming convention: "redwood-trace-<short-id>.json". For CSV ensure UTF-8 BOM for Excel friendliness.
Renee M.: placement debate: small persistent badge in header showing pin count vs a collapsible dock beside the trace list. Badge is subtle and discoverable; dock is more discoverable during investigations. Thoughts?
Noah K.: hybrid: persistent badge in header that opens the board, plus a collapsible floating dock while in the trace view. Floating dock must be dismissible with ESC and not overlap critical content on small screens.
Omar T.: accessibility: when dock opens it must trap focus, announce "Board opened" via aria-live, and restore focus when closed. Also ensure high-contrast and keyboard-only flows work.
ux-bot: uploaded preview image (preview-1732109876.png)
Renee M.: action items: Renee - update figma with both header badge + dock variants; Omar - prototype keyboard interactions and announce behavior; Noah - spike client-side localStorage + export streaming; Priya - finalize inline copy and export modal text.
Priya S.: timeline: MVP client-only ship in 1 sprint if we scope export to max 5 traces per bundle.
Noah K.: will implement behind feature flag and add telemetry events for pin.add, pin.remove, export.start, export.complete, copy.permalink.
Renee M.: thanks team 94 I'll post updated mockups and a short demo when ready.
